customRules.title: EPF Wage Ceiling ₹25,000 (Eff. 17 Sep 2026)
customRules.summary: EPFO wage ceiling ₹15,000 se badh kar ₹25,000/month (Basic+DA) ho chuki hai. Max employee share ₹3,000 aur max EPS pension ₹2,083.
customRules.auditorNote: Sep 2026+ sheets par ₹15,000 cap lock hone par short-deduction demand aa sakti hai.

customRules.title: Code on Wages 50% Basic & 50% Max Deduction Cap
customRules.summary: Basic+DA kam se kam 50% CTC hona chahiye; total deductions earned gross ke 50% se upar nahi ja sakti; F&F 2 working days mein mandatory hai.
customRules.auditorNote: High advance deductions ya low basic% par auditor add-back / illegal deduction mark karta hai.
